name: Idle Planet Destroyer 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Idle Planet Destroyer is a cosmic idle clicker game where your mission is simple: destroy planets, collect stardust, and build the most powerful arsenal in the universe. Tap planets to deal damage, earn Stardust, and invest in devastating upgrades such as Laser Pistols, Micro Drones, Plasma Rifles, Orbital Lasers, Antimatter Bombs, Dyson Cannons, Reality Erasers, and other universe-breaking weapons.
